option_relations.rationale: Age-related cardiac conduction disease is a general category, while the leaf specifies a symptomatic third-degree AV block with bifascicular block, which is more specific than the option.
Complete heart block (Third-degree AV block) is a component of the more specific diagnosis in the leaf, which also includes bifascicular block and symptomatic presentation.
Third-degree atrioventricular block is a component of the more specific diagnosis in the leaf, which also includes bifascicular block and symptomatic presentation.

The option describes trifascicular heart block (bifascicular block with first-degree AV block progressing to complete heart block), which aligns with the leaf's description of symptomatic third-degree AV block with bifascicular block (RBBB and LAFB) and the ECG findings of first-degree AV block, RBBB, and LAFB progressing to third-degree AV block.
